modelDescription: eveloped in collaboration between American Defense Manufacturing and iRayUSA, the AC55 Flip-to-Side mount is designed for the RICO MICRO (RH25V2), enabling seamless integration with a day optic like an LPVO or a holographic sight with magnifier. Instead of removing and reinstalling a thermal clip-on unit, users can simply flip the MICRO in or out of place to transition between thermal and day optics. The mount’s versatile design allows for multiple configurations depending on the desired side of the hinge and QD lever placement. Built from machined aluminum with a durable anodized finish, it provides a rock-solid 2.05-inch co-witness height for reliable alignment and performance in the field. With this new mounting option, the most versatile thermal optic in the world just got even better.
